caseNameFull: Edward C. Ward v. State of Washington
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State of Washington.
attorneys: Mr. W. F. Magill, with whom Mr. H. S. Wilson, Mr. Donald MacMaster and Mr. Geo. A. Brodie were on the briefs, for plaintiff in error., Mr. L. L. Thompson, with whom Mr. Nat. U. Brown was on the brief, for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Gasquet v. Lapeyre, 242 U. S. 367, 369-370.
